ns2:section.sectionText: Here is a chance to network and meet with premier athletic organizations, media companies, and advertising agencies. Experience Portland, Oregon to learn about the culture and careers from industry professionals as well as cutting-edge and emerging organizations. Potential visits include; Nike, Adidas, Under Armor, Columbia, Portland Timbers & Trailblazers, Wieden + Kennedy, R/GA, Downstream, Instrument and more. Trip Date: May 14 - 19, 2018. Course Fee: $1,495 (billed to your student account). Scholarships and financial aid may apply. Apply before 3/11/2018 at https://forms.illinois.edu/sec/3335132 . Notifications of acceptance will be sent by 3/12/2018. Commitment to course is required by 3/14/2018.
